g.text: Continuation of the network’s nine-peak orbits
Every accepted node is shown. A failed corrector is unresolved; brackets are numerical candidates.
Multiplier axes: symmetric log, linear within ±2. Signed real multipliers are shown; complex dominant pairs use their modulus.
